The '''Principality of Burthorpe''', referred to colloquially as '''Burthorpe''', is a military principality north-west of [[Falador]] and north of [[Taverley]]. It's led by [[Prince Anlaf|Crown Prince Anlaf]] and is home to the [[Burthorpe Imperial Guard]], who defend the [[Burthorpe Castle|citadel]] standing between Burthorpe and [[Trollheim]] against [[trolls]] in the ongoing [[Burthorpe–Troll Country War]].

Burthorpe is one of the only locations in [[Asgarnia]] that isn't directly controlled by the [[White Knights]], who many of Burthorpe's residents believe are taking advantage of Asgarnia's [[King Vallance|King]], the father of Prince Anlaf.
